docs.eventNameAlias: Canonical runtime event-name strings carried inside `EasyBarEventToken.name`.
docs.eventNameAliasExtra: In normal widget code, prefer `easybar.events.*` tokens over comparing raw strings.
docs.networkEventData: Structured network-specific fields that may be present on network-related events.
docs.powerEventData: Structured power-specific fields that may be present on charging or power-source events.
docs.audioEventData: Structured audio-specific fields that may be present on mute or volume events.
docs.event: The event payload object delivered to event handlers.
docs.eventExtra: Different event families populate different optional fields.
docs.eventHandler: The callback signature used by `node:subscribe(...)` and `easybar.subscribe(...)`.
docs.eventToken: Opaque subscribe token object passed through from `easybar.events.*`.
docs.mouseEventsClass: Mouse-specific interaction tokens and convenience constants nested under `easybar.events.mouse`.
docs.eventsClassExtra: Use these tokens when subscribing widgets instead of hard-coding event-name strings.
docs.captureDeviceData: One connected camera or microphone included in capture-related events.
docs.captureEventData: Normalized camera and microphone inventory and activity state.

intervalEvent.doc: Internal timer callback name delivered to the widget whose own `interval` schedule elapsed.

forcedEvent.doc: Fired when EasyBar or `easybar` triggers a manual refresh.

events.doc: Fired when the pointer enters the subscribed node frame.
